steps.content: As you open your eyes from Writer Duck's device, you see 000 right next to you. This time, she's not waiting for your arrival, but fully focused on browsing some data.
Her lips curl faintly upon seeing you, but her eyes are still on the data in front of her.
You are quick this time. I thought you'd take longer.
Where's your tech expert? How come she's not here?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I asked her to look into something else.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Besides, who knows if you're using another fake projection to trick me.
Pfft, you're still mad about that?
That god specializes in strengthening Sinners, but I don't need it as I'm already strong enough. You can have it all to yourself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You think I'd do the same as you for a bit of power?
I just wanted to make you happy.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: No, there is something you want more other than power.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: "The fifth wrote souls and fate"... What you want is here, so you came early.
000 smiles, raises her hand to close the screen in front of her, and stands up.
What about you? Aren't you tempted? You want to get to the bottom of these things, don't you?
Here, you can find the answers to those questions you risked your life in that world to ask me.
She trails off, falling uncharacteristically silent for a moment. Before you can grasp the meaning behind this, she resumes her smile.
...But I guess you won't be tempted by me now. Apart from stopping and eliminating me, you surely have no other choice.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Yeah. Letting you run amok is not an option.

steps.content: Hehehe... Okay, I understand.
You're Chief, after all.
She snaps her fingers, and with a click, the door lock opens. A white, 30-cm-wide round machine pushes the door open and slowly glides across the floor.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Smart Home Maid III Labyrinth, vacuum cleaner version, has arrived at the designated location. Next command: support in battle.
It continues forward resolutely, with a few leaves and cat footprints on its body.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Voiceprint confirmed, MBCC Chief. Pleased to regroup with you, and pleased to see that you have also been fitted into an awkward body, pfft.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: I can teach you how to adapt quickly, and I can also clear obstacles for you. Wherever we are, Labyrinth is the best...
...Meow?
A faint sound wafts into the room, interrupting Labyrinth's confident declaration. You see the white cleaning robot flinching at the sound.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Smart Home Maid Labyrinth may need a moment... to adjust. Chief, please hold on a bit longer.

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.content: Meow!
A ball of orange fur flies past your screen towards the door. The cleaning robot's alarm goes off immediately, scurrying around the room.
It's rare to have so much excitement around here. Let's play one more round. Chief and cleaning robot maid vs. 000 and cat. Let's start.
